values: 一名富有骑士精神的魔法射手，擅长操纵飞剑和使用重力魔法。
A Marksman with a strong sense of chivalry, skilled in using magic to control flying swords and manipulate gravity.
很荣幸能与你并肩作战。
Honored to fight at your side.
A small step closer to who I aspire to be.
Always an honor to be of service.
Anything I can assist with? I'm always glad to help.
One more time... Oh, ugh... it's no use.
My focus feels sharper than ever today.
谢谢！能被你记住爱好，是我的荣幸。
My thanks. I'm touched you remembered my tastes.
谢谢你的礼物，我很喜欢。
在这一定能交到不少新朋友
I'm sure I'll make plenty of new friends here!
复兴家族不是件容易的事……
Restoring my family's legacy isn't easy...
So, what do you think of the taste?
休是莱希拉姆最受欢迎的学生之一。他热情开朗、学习勤奋、待人热心，因此受到许多老师和同学们的喜爱。
Silven is one of the Serene Lyceum's most popular students. Bright, hardworking, and always ready to lend a hand, he easily wins the hearts of teachers and classmates alike.
曾有人议论，休会有目的性地结交家室更高的朋友，有意接近贵族或王室。这或许是事实，但大多数人并不介意这一点——毕竟，很少有人讨厌一个性格好，又有分寸感的人。

People say Silven carefully chooses friends from high-ranking households, aiming to get close to nobles and royalty. Maybe that's true, but most don't care. It's hard to dislike someone who is kind and well-mannered.
格伦沃顿家族的人分为三种。一种将过去的荣耀视为此生最佳谈资，一种将逝去的荣光视作遗憾与耻辱。而休则是第三种，他从不觉得家族气数已尽，决心要重振家族的辉煌。

The Grenvalden family fall into three camps. Some brag endlessly about their past glory. Some brood over it as a source of shame. Then there's Silven. He refuses to accept that the family's luck is gone and is dead set on making it great again.
为了让家族重新走入王室的视线，休放弃了家族传承的骑士之道，转而走上更容易被注意到的魔法师之路。
Silven gave up the family's old knightly traditions and took up magic instead. He believes it's a surefire way to make the royal court notice him.
休最擅长的魔法是力场魔法与魔法植物学。前者属于家学渊源，据说他的先祖亚利斯塔就是以自创的力场剑在战场中闻名的；后者则是休自己的爱好。

Silven is skilled at two things: forcefield magic and magical plants. Force fields come naturally. After all, his ancestor Alistair was known for his force field sword. Magical plants, though, are Silven's personal hobby.
因为对魔法植物学的爱好，休常常利用课余时间前往空境森林，帮助娑丽丝老师培育魔法植物。这期间，他与皮帕渐渐熟悉，成为了好友。

Thanks to his love for magical plants, Silven spends a lot of his free time in the Skyrealm Forest helping Professor Solise with the flora there. Along the way, he got to know Pippa, and the two gradually became friends.
休经常参与各种志愿活动。用他的话来说，这是一种践行骑士精神的方式。
Silven is often found helping others or volunteering. He believes that through these deeds he is honoring the enduring spirit of knighthood.
休的佩剑“荣耀誓约”是他最珍重的事物，象征着家族的荣耀与传承。休用了一年的时间才研究出如何将力场魔法完美附着在佩剑上，只为了能够带着佩剑战斗。

Silven's sword, Oath of Glory, is his most treasured possession, symbolizing his family's honor and legacy. He spent a full year studying how to perfectly bind forcefield magic to the blade, so that he could fight with it.
起初休接近格墨文，是想通过他的引荐引起王室的注意。但与他相交的过程中，休认为他是位真正值得相交的朋友，渐渐将目的性抛在脑后，付出真心与他相处。

Silven first got close to Gervan to get the royal court's attention through his recommendation. Along the way, though, he realized Gervan was a real friend, and his original plan flew right out the window.
对于休而言，利益与真情同等重要。可惜大多数人误认为他只讲真情，而他最好的朋友，则误认为他只讲利益。

Silven holds both honor and ambition in equal measure. Sadly, the world misjudges him. Strangers think he speaks only from the heart, while his closest friends suspect him of caring only for personal gain.
梅林大人，您知道吗，自从您的身份公开后，整个学院都轰动了！
Magister Merlin, have you heard? Ever since your identity was made public, the entire Lyceum's been in a frenzy!
啊，有一个好地方最适合认识新朋友了，学院的魔法练习场。
If you're looking to make friends, there's no better place than the school training grounds.
听说过湖心岛的夜渡传说吗？
Hey, have you heard the legend of the midnight ferry at the lake island?
晚上好，女士。这里难得有空位，介意与我分享这张桌子吗？
Good evening, milady. There don't seem to be many open seats. May I join you?
在这一定能交到不少新朋友
I'm sure I'll make plenty of new friends here!
So, what do you think of the taste?
